verdicts.statement: Location is an important factor when buying an investment property.
verdicts.reason: The context identifies the location of the property as the first decision to make and explains its impact on investment returns.

verdicts.statement: A property in a desirable, sought-after area may generate good long-term capital returns.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that a property in a good, sought-after area can produce good capital returns over the long run.

verdicts.statement: A property in a desirable, sought-after area may generate good rental returns.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that buying in a good, sought-after area can yield good rental returns.

verdicts.statement: A property in an area with little demand may be difficult to rent.
verdicts.reason: The context states that buying in an area where no one wants to live may lead to problems renting the property out.

verdicts.statement: A property in an area with little demand may attract problematic tenants who cause damage.
verdicts.reason: The context states that a property in an undesirable area may only be rentable to bad tenants who cause damage.

verdicts.statement: A property in an area with little demand may provide little or no capital gain over many years.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly warns that a property in an undesirable area may not produce any capital gains over many years.

verdicts.statement: The location should be carefully evaluated before purchasing.
verdicts.reason: The context presents location as the first purchasing decision and explains how choosing a good or poor area can affect rental income, tenants, and capital gains.
